title: Verify
description: Full-viewport screen that takes the one-time code emailed after sign-up, composing the login-form block in its verify mode: one cell per digit with autocomplete="one-time-code", the address carried in a hidden input so a resend still posts without JavaScript, and a second submit that asks for a new code once the countdown is up. Presentational — data and callbacks in, no navigation state and no timer of its own — and responsive to its container (@container) across the @sm and @md contract steps: the masthead lines up at @sm and the footer at @md.
